_doc: The bomb on a bridge looked at in play (look.gd): a road raised 9 m over bare land at both ends (set_road_height), the strongest charge on its deck; the deck is cut and the ground under it keeps no crater, its heave nor its decal (the crater was dug in the deck, Crater::y). Then a small charge on the deck further on (the pointer's point is the deck): its crater's mark lies on the deck, which stands. setView's y is the ground's -z.
